Implemented `refund_shipping` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Validates and normalizes `at` with `ensure_utc`.
- Rounds the amount via `round_money` and rejects non-positive amounts with `BillingError("non_positive_amount", ...)`.
- Requires the payment to be `captured`.
- Rejects refunds exceeding the captured amount with `BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", ...)`.
- Accumulates `payment.refunded_amount`, sets status to `"refunded"` when fully refunded, records an audit event, and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, including edge-case checks.
